title: Roof Replacement in Portland, OR
summary: In May 2025, French Roofing replaced the flat roof on a building in Portland, OR. The crew tore off the old roofing, screwed down half-inch dense deck board for fire protection, and covered the roof in a new white TPO membrane, with new TPO boots on the vent pipes and TPO breather vents.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old roofing
Installed 1/2 inch dense deck board for fire protection, fastened with 2.5 inch screws and plates
Installed a new white TPO membrane over the dense deck
New TPO boots (witch hats) on the vent pipes and new TPO breather vents
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the grounds for nails

faqs.question: What went under the new TPO on this Portland flat roof?
faqs.answer: Half-inch dense deck board, screwed down with 2.5 inch screws and plates, for fire protection. The white TPO membrane went on over it.
